# Instructions

## Goal

This is a resume website with the purpose of showcasing my resume.

## Overall Structure

This code is based on a template. I have docker and docker-compose files for simplified deployment. Most code is in the `src` directory. Assets, like images for the web pages, are in the `public` directory.

## Guidelines

Always follow best practices. Feel free to look at many files as needed to complete  your task.
